description: This file defines a React component for managing invoice items within an invoice creation form. It includes UI elements for listing, adding, editing, and removing invoice items, utilizing react-hook-form for form state management and custom dialog modals for item input.

classes.name: InvoiceItemsSection
classes.description: React functional component that displays a list of invoice items with options to add, edit, or remove items.

classes.name: HandleItemModal
classes.description: React component that manages a modal dialog for adding or editing an invoice item, including form handling and submission.

methods.name: onHandleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for adding or editing an invoice item, updating the parent component's state accordingly.
